description: TODAY'S CASE: Which apology works after an AI gives bad advice? Choice a means “Short apology” is wrong: Say the answer was wrong, apologize once, and immediately provide the corrected answer without explaining the model's internal process. Choice b means “Full explanation” is wrong: Explain why the mistake happened, identify the unreliable assumption, and show the user how the corrected conclusion was reached. Choice both means both are wrong. Pick a side, give one reason, and get a public receipt plus a leaderboard point.

rationale.description: One concise reason for the verdict.
